name: Single-Arm Pull-Up
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with one hand in a firm overhand grip, shoulder packed down, and free arm held clear of the bar.
Brace your entire trunk and glutes tightly to minimize torso spinning.
Pull smoothly upward by driving your working elbow toward your ribs until your chin clears the bar.
Lower under strict control back to a straight-arm hang, then switch arms after completing one side.
tips: Engage your shoulder blade before bending your elbow to protect the shoulder joint at the bottom.
Keep your body rigid and avoid kicking your legs to swing upward.
